text: Comprehension [Lat. comprehendere , to grasp]: Ger. Begreifen ; Fr. compréhension , savoir ; Ital. comprensione . Knowledge of the relational or apperceptive type -- 'knowledge about' -- as contrasted with that of the immediate or intuitive type -- 'acquaintance with.' Cf. KNOWLEDGE. ( J.M.B. , G.F.S. )
